title: 第5章 我满足你的要求第6章 你敢磨嘰一下我便给你一剑
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 一声惨叫，苏玄的身体犹如断了线的风箏，狠狠地摔在地上。
和苏阳一个下场，血轮被剑气贯穿。
鸦雀无声，没有人敢发出丝毫声音，全部傻傻地看著面前一幕。
谁都没有想到。
苏辰敢出手毁掉大爷的血轮，可要知道，血轮对於武者来说，如同生命重要，一旦失去血轮，只能终生停留在先天境，再无望筑基。
“你可以不是人，而我苏辰却有著属於自己的底线。”
苏玄始终都是他的大伯，他不是无情的妖兽，无法做到屠杀自己的家人，却会毁掉苏阳和苏玄的血轮，这便是招惹他所要付出的代价。
所有人都被嚇傻了，苏辰实在太强了，连八级筑基境的大爷，都无法抵挡住苏辰的一剑，这是何等的可怕。
最重要的是，家主並未出手阻拦。
“爷爷，我和苏昊之间的恩怨，不会连累到家族，从现在开始，我苏辰自逐家族，再不是苏家弟子，稍后便会离开苏家，父亲和此事没有关係，请善待父亲。”
听到此话，所有人脸色都很是动容，都没有想到，苏辰会选择自逐家族。
一声声嘆息。
更新不易，记得分享101看书网
想要保住家族的人，却在强大的苏族面前，连一丝丝办法都没有。
看著转身离去的身影，苏渊痛苦地闭上双眼。
原本属於苏辰的帝骨，不仅被苏昊剥夺，更是迫於苏族威慑，要眼睁睁地看著孙子离开家族，他这个做爷爷的，却只能够接受。
“將苏玄带下去好好照顾。”
“父亲，难道真的让苏辰自逐家族离开？”
“此事到此为止，吩咐下去，任何人不得擅自议论此事，违令者，杀！”
冰室內。
四面都是一块块巨大的冰块，常年保持寒冰状態，正中央的巨大冰块上，摆放著一口冰棺，通体冰蓝色。
冰棺里面躺著一位中年男子，容顏和苏辰有著七分相似，静静地躺著，犹如活死人一般。
苏辰的身影出现在冰室。
看著面前的冰棺，尤其是躺在冰棺內的男子，双膝慢慢跪下。
“父亲，孩儿不孝，因为某种特殊原因，已经自逐家族，即將离开家族。”
“有朝一日，孩儿必定相助父亲醒来。”
苏战，曾经的东荒第一强者，威慑各族和宗门，如今却只能躺在冰棺內，成为活死人。
苏家试过无数种方法，都没有办法能够让苏战醒来。
突然间！
苏辰体內的龙象血脉开始翻滚起来，一滴龙象精血强行逼出体外，快速地融入冰棺內。
下一秒钟。
冰棺內传出强烈的龙象波动，宛如海潮疯狂地涌入苏辰的脑海。
足足融合了半个时辰，苏辰才缓缓睁开双眼。
“九龙九象术！”
苏辰能够猜得出来，自己被封印的龙象血脉，还有刚刚从冰棺內获得的九龙九象术，必定有著不为人知的秘密，奈何父亲成为活死人，无法告诉自己。
脚步声响起。
content_en:
With a scream, Su Xuan's body fell to the ground like a kite with its string broken.
The same fate as Su Yang, the blood wheel was penetrated by the sword energy.
There was total silence, no one dared to make the slightest sound, they all stared stupidly at the scene in front of them.
No one expected it.
Su Chen dared to destroy the uncle's blood wheel, but you must know that the blood wheel is as important as life to a warrior. Once the blood wheel is lost, he can only stay in the innate realm for life, with no hope of building a foundation.
"You may not be human, but I, Su Chen, have my own bottom line."
Su Xuan has always been his uncle. He is not a ruthless monster. He cannot kill his family, but he will destroy the blood wheels of Su Yang and Su Xuan. This is the price to pay for provoking him.
Everyone was frightened. Su Chen was too strong. Even the eighth-level Foundation Establishment Realm uncle couldn't withstand Su Chen's sword. This was so terrifying.
The most important thing is that the head of the family did not stop it.
"Grandpa, the grievances between Su Hao and I will not affect the family. From now on, I, Su Chen, will oust myself from the family. I will no longer be a disciple of the Su family. I will leave the Su family later. My father has nothing to do with this matter. Please be kind to my father."
After hearing this, everyone's expressions were very moved, and no one thought that Su Chen would choose to expel himself from the family.
A sigh.

People who want to keep their family have no way to do it in front of the powerful Su clan.
Seeing the figure turning away, Su Yuan closed his eyes in pain.
The imperial bones that originally belonged to Su Chen were not only deprived by Su Hao, but also forced by the Su clan's intimidation to watch his grandson leave the family. As a grandfather, he could only accept it.
"Take Su Xuan down and take good care of him."
"Father, do you really want Su Chen to drive away from the family?"
"This matter ends here. Go ahead and tell me that no one is allowed to discuss this matter without permission. Anyone who disobeys the order will be killed!"
"Yes."
~~~~~~
Inside the ice room.
There are huge pieces of ice on all sides, which remain cold all year round. On the huge ice cube in the center, there is an ice coffin, which is completely ice blue.
Inside the ice coffin lay a middle-aged man, whose appearance was very similar to Su Chen's. He lay quietly, like a living dead.
Su Chen's figure appeared in the ice room.
Looking at the ice coffin in front of him, especially the man lying in the ice coffin, he slowly knelt down on his knees.
"Father, the child is unfilial. For some special reason, he has been expelled from the family and is about to leave the family."
"One day, the child will help his father wake up."
Su Zhan, once the most powerful man in the Eastern Wasteland, intimidated all tribes and sects, but now he can only lie in an ice coffin and become a living dead.
The Su family tried countless methods, but there was no way to wake up Su Zhan.
suddenly!
The dragon-elephant blood in Su Chen's body began to tumble, and a drop of dragon-elephant blood was forced out of the body and quickly integrated into the ice coffin.
The next second.
Strong dragon-elephant fluctuations came from the ice coffin, like a sea wave rushing crazily into Su Chen's mind.
After fusing for half an hour, Su Chen slowly opened his eyes.
"Nine Dragons and Nine Elephants Technique!"
Su Chen could guess that his sealed dragon-elephant bloodline and the Nine Dragons and Nine Elephants Technique he had just obtained from the ice coffin must have unknown secrets. However, his father became a living dead and could not tell him.
Footsteps sounded.
